name: solana
description: Solana as one mod. A Solana address is 32 opaque bytes that will not tell you what it is, so this module starts there: ask once and it says whether you hold a wallet, a token mint, a token account, a stake account or a program — then answers the question you actually had. Price a wallet across SOL and every SPL token; decode a transaction into the net SOL and token movement per owner rather than raw account indexes; read a mint's supply, authorities and liquidity risk; quote a swap through Jupiter with real price impact; read the validator set and the Nakamoto coefficient that says how few could halt the chain. It writes too: transfers of SOL and SPL tokens are signed in-process with a key from an off-tree keystore, creating the recipient's token account when it does not exist. And it handles programs end to end — load one to see its loader, its upgrade authority, its syscalls and its anchor IDL; call an instruction by name with borsh-encoded arguments and simulate it before signing; deploy an ELF from a file, from base64, or cloned off another cluster, as a background job that writes it in chunks and verifies every byte; then upgrade it, hand the authority over, revoke it forever, or close it for the rent. Twenty-two MCP tools, a REST API and a browser console run the same code on one port, so an agent, a shell and a human never see different answers.

endpoints.transfer: POST /transfer {to, amount, mint?, wallet?, confirm?} — write-gated
endpoints.swap: POST /swap {input, output, amount, slippage_bps?, wallet?, confirm?, dry_run?} — trade through Jupiter's best route, signed here (write-gated)
endpoints.idl: GET|POST /idl {program, action=get|set|clear, idl?} — a program's interface
endpoints.deploy: POST /deploy {path|data|clone, program?, wallet?, confirm?} — write-gated; GET /deploy?action=list|status&job=
endpoints.invoke: POST /invoke {program, ix?, args?, accounts?, data?, send?} — simulate, or send (send=true is write-gated)
endpoints.pda: GET|POST /pda {program, seeds} — derive a program address

backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib); base58 and ed25519 implemented in-tree, with a PyNaCl/cryptography fast path when present

keys.env: SOLANA_SECRET_KEY — a keypair array, base58 secret, hex seed, or a path
keys.rule: no house wallet — a transfer signs with a key the caller controls and the seed never leaves the process
keys.programs: a deploy generates a program keypair and a buffer keypair and writes both to the keystore before it uses them — the program key IS the address

auth.writes: Authorization: Bearer <~/.mod/solana/server.secret>; with no secret file the signing routes answer only on loopback

env.PORT: port for API, console and MCP (default 50710)
env.SOLANA_RPC: default RPC endpoint — set your own when the public one throttles
env.SOLANA_SPEND_USD: value guard: a transfer worth more needs confirm=true (default 25)
